name: blog-to-epub-extension
description: Chrome extension that converts the current article tab into an EPUB, reusing the shared lib/ pipeline.

scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && rm -f ../blog-to-epub-extension.zip && zip -rX ../blog-to-epub-extension.zip . -x '.DS_Store'
scripts.test: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e
